claim: Disrobe detects 93 of 190 labeled command-injection flows in the NIST SARD Juliet v1.3 char/system C corpus with gcc 16.2.0 -O2, with zero false positives.
detail: 93 of 190 labeled command-injection flows recalled across the 8 populated categories (48.9%), precision 100% (93 of 93 flagged findings land on a corpus-labeled bad chain, 0 false positives against any of the 190 good-labeled counterparts). The other 7 declared categories (container, callback, virtual call, string operation, sanitiser-severs, recursion, library boundary) hold 0 cases in this corpus slice. The same corpus and engine at -O0 recall only 12 of 190 (6.3%); the move from a prior 39 of 190 (20.5%) to 93 of 190 came from teaching the engine to track a source call's out-argument register, not from this row's own wiring.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-taint/tests/graded_corpus.rs, assert_fresh_o2_grade_still_clears_the_published_floor, sum over the 8 populated categories; ground truth is manifest.xml and each file's own Flow Variant header

oracle.external: NIST SARD Juliet Test Suite for C/C++ v1.3 (2017-10-01), CWE-78 char/system C files. The grader reads manifest.xml flaw locations and Flow Variant headers. Each group contributes one verdict for its bad-labeled call chain and one for its good-labeled chain.
oracle.note: These figures cover native input compiled from C. Seven of the 15 declared flow categories have no cases in this slice: container, callback, virtual call, string operation, sanitiser, recursion, and library boundary. With gcc 16.2.0 -O0, detection is 12 of 190 flows (6.3%), with zero false positives. Flow across more than one call remains 0 of 15 at both optimization levels. The separate published_juliet_o2_bars_match_the_pinned_floors test checks the published counts without compiling the corpus.

reproduce: DISROBE_REQUIRE_JULIET_CORPUS=1 cargo test -p disrobe-taint --test graded_corpus juliet_cwe78_command_injection_precision_recall_o2 -- --exact --nocapture. CI does not provision the pinned Juliet corpus cache.
title: Native taint analysis on Juliet CWE-78
